abstract: This series comprises of a variety of sacrococcygeal masses other than meningomyelocele that presented to the department of pediatric surgery of Medical College Kolkata over last 10 years. In this series, 23 cases of sacrococcygeal masses are included. Barring meningomyelocele, teratoma constitutes a major group of cases. It also includes few other interesting and atypical masses such as presacral dermoid, degenerated nerve fiber, fibrofatty tissue, rhabdomyosarcoma, etc. This is an endeavor to enlighten ourselves so that the diagnosis and management of unfamiliar sacrococcygeal masses can be done.
abstract_ja: 本シリーズは、10年間に小児外科で扱った髄膜瘤以外の仙尾部腫瘤23例からなる。奇形腫は髄膜瘤を除くと主要な群を占める。その他、骨盤内類皮嚢腫、変性神経線維、線維脂肪組織、横紋筋肉腫など、興味深く非典型的な腫瘤も含まれる。本報告は、なじみの少ない仙尾部腫瘤の診断と管理を理解する一助となることを目的とする。
